definition: an organ that cleans waste from blood
description: A dim clinic room lit by a desk lamp. A young woman with long red hair lies on an examination couch in a navy T-shirt, while a smiling young woman in navy scrubs holds an ultrasound probe against her side and points at the screen of the ultrasound machine, which shows a grey bean-shaped kidney. The patient looks at the screen, and the woman in scrubs then turns to her and smiles. A poster with two red kidneys stands behind them, and a bottle of gel and a paper towel roll sit on a metal trolley in front.
